fi-n-seasons.label: LSG seasons in the warehouse
fi-n-seasons.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fi-n-seasons.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) won FROM matches m WHERE (m.team1_id IN (13) OR m.team2_id IN (13)) AND m.winner_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY year ORDER BY year

fi-titles.label: LSG titles, as winner of the season's final
fi-titles.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fi-titles.filters: Final = last match of each season
fi-titles.query: SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) year, CASE WHEN m.winner_id IN (13) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END won FROM matches m WHERE m.date = (SELECT MAX(x.date) FROM matches x WHERE x.season_id = m.season_id) AND (m.team1_id IN (13) OR m.team2_id IN (13))

fi-runner.label: Lucknow Super Giants' leading run-scorer in 2022
fi-runner.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fi-runner.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2022 GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 1

fi-runs.label: Runs by that player in 2022
fi-runs.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fi-runs.query: SELECT pl.name, SUM(d.batter_runs) runs FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.batter_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (13) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2022 GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY runs DESC LIMIT 1

fi-bowler.label: Lucknow Super Giants' leading wicket-taker in 2022
fi-bowler.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fi-bowler.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) wk FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (13) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2022 AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY wk DESC LIMIT 1

fi-wk.label: Wickets by that player in 2022
fi-wk.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
fi-wk.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(*) wk FROM dismissals x JOIN deliveries d ON d.delivery_id = x.delivery_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = d.bowler_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (13) AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) = 2022 AND x.kind NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'retired out', 'obstructing the field') GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY wk DESC LIMIT 1

fi-founders.query: SELECT pl.name, COUNT(DISTINCT x.y) seasons, MIN(x.y) first, MAX(x.y) last FROM ( SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) y, d.batter_id pid FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.batting_team_id IN (13) UNION SELECT CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) y, d.bowler_id pid FROM deliveries d JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = d.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = d.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND i.bowling_team_id IN (13)) x JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id = x.pid GROUP BY pl.name ORDER BY seasons DESC, pl.name
